title: Mixing Raw SQL Mapping and ORM Queries in the Same Database Layer
pattern: Using raw SQL mapping queries alongside an ORM query builder for the same database tables in the same persistence module.
why_bad: It breaks data access consistency, creating dual maintenance overhead whenever database schemas change and leading to subtle schema-desynchronization bugs.
detection: Modules that import both ORM table definitions and raw string query executables targeting the same database tables.
counterexample: Raw SQL used exclusively for highly optimized, read-only bulk query operations that cannot be generated cleanly by the ORM. Marked `Context-dependent`.
fix: Unify on a single data access strategy (e.g., using the ORM query builder) for the database.
